reasoning: 驗證目標：Seek Up 啟動時，若 HU 已在最高頻道，則調諧到最低頻道（wrap-around）。關鍵情境條件：起始頻道恰為 lineup 的highest端——這是條文給出的邊界。為什麼這樣切：驗證對象是 lineup 端點這個邊界，設計方法採邊界值分析；一條 TC 覆蓋單一觸發的必然結果，依 §5.7 不拆分。程序另在端點前一個頻道各驗一次，確認 wrap 只發生在端點而非提前（§7）。依 Profile §4，wrap-around 是所屬功能的邊界而非獨立功能，因此不另立能力。

tcs.tc_title: Seek Up at the highest channel wraps to the lowest
tcs.test_item: Upon initiation of a Seek Up function, if the HU is on the highest channel number, the HU shall tune to the lowest channel number (wrap-around)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. The channel lineup's highest and lowest channel numbers are known
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Tune the HU one channel short of the highest channel and note the channel number
2. Initiate Seek Up and read the tuned channel
3. Initiate Seek Up again and read the tuned channel
4. Read the channel number against the lineup
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU is tuned one channel short of the highest channel
2. The HU tunes to the highest channel, without wrapping
3. The HU tunes to the lowest channel of the lineup
4. The tuned channel is the lowest channel number, not a channel adjacent to the highest one
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
